name: Wind Ward
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, you create swirling winds out to short range that move with you. Distribute five temporary +1 Defense bonuses among creatures in the area as you choose. If the condition you unchecked was Troubled, double the number of bonuses.

When a creature with one or more bonuses takes damage from an attack, it loses all its bonuses unless you check a Condition. A creature also loses its bonuses if it leaves the area.

On your turn, you may spend a half action to redistribute any remaining bonuses among creatures within the winds.

Describe the winds.
